verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS company-formation and back-office platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis to ask about. The pack contains no evidence of any official SDK. The only nearby item is a pricing-page line, "Advanced API integrations", which is an adjacent feature listing, not a documented SDK, and probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
